data.narrative:
CreateMe operates in Robotics & Manufacturing as a private company at an undisclosed stage. The available comp universe consists of one public peer (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private robotics companies, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The Peer-Median method is not applicable to this valuation. The analysis identified ten same-sector peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, but filtering by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any narrow cohort. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial methodological noise and obscure rather than clarify CreateMe's relative positioning. This constraint reflects the sparse, heterogeneous nature of the robotics private market at present.

Given the inapplicability of the primary triangulation method and the absence of disclosed financial metrics for CreateMe or its comparables, a quantitative valuation range cannot be supported by the data provided. The key uncertainty is stage classification and growth profile relative to the identified peer set. Any valuation effort would require either (1) granular financial data on at least three sufficiently similar stage-matched peers, or (2) CreateMe's own revenue, funding history, and capital efficiency metrics. Without these inputs, multiples-based or DCF analysis remains premature.
